content:
# Disagreement Log — 1QM Column 5

| # | Line | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Category | Resolution |
|---|------|------|-------|--------|----------|------------|
| 1 | 5:1 | "They-shall-place" | "They shall place" | "are to be deployed" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "They shall deploy" — PNEUMA's verb with LOGOS's structure |
| 2 | 5:2 | "men-of valor" | "men of valor" | "courageous men" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "men of valor" — Hebrew 'anshei chayil best rendered formally |
| 3 | 5:3 | "breastplates-of armor" | "coats of armor" | "body armor" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "coats of armor" — LOGOS; PNEUMA too generic; EMET mixes terms |
| 4 | 5:4 | "circular-shields" | "round shields" | "round shields" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "round shields" — LOGOS/PNEUMA agree; EMET's "circular" awkward |
| 5 | 5:5 | "to-slay those-who-are-slain-of God" | "to slay those slain by God" | "to cut down those God has marked for death" | Interpretive | SOPHIA: "to slay those marked for death by God" — blends LOGOS/PNEUMA |
| 6 | 5:7 | "swift-of foot and tender-of mouth" | "swift of foot, gentle of mouth" | "fast, responsive to the reins" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "swift of foot, responsive to the rein" — EMET's "foot" + PNEUMA's "responsive" |
| 7 | 5:7 | "long-of wind and full-of days" | "long of wind, and mature in years" | "with excellent endurance and fully trained" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "long of wind, and fully trained" — blends EMET's idiom with PNEUMA's clarity |
| 8 | 5:8 | "practiced runners, and men who-know-how to-ride" | "trained runners, with men who know how to ride them" | "experienced runners, ridden by skilled horsemen" | Structural | SOPHIA: "experienced runners, ridden by skilled horsemen" — PNEUMA's concision preferred |
| 9 | 5:9 | "the saddle-cloths" | "the saddle cloths" | "the saddle blankets" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "the saddle cloths" — LOGOS; technical term preserved |
| 10 | 5:10 | "helmets and greaves upon-their-legs" | "helmets and greaves on their legs" | "helmets and leg armor" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "helmets and greaves on their legs" — LOGOS preserves specific term |
| 11 | 5:11 | "shall-be girded upon-their-loins" | "shall be girded on their waists" | "will be strapped to their waists" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "shall be strapped to their waists" — PNEUMA's "strapped" more natural |
| 12 | 5:13 | "perfect-of spirit and flesh" | "sound in spirit and body" | "sound in mind and body" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "sound in spirit and body" — LOGOS/PNEUMA blend; "spirit" > "mind" |
| 13 | 5:14 | "the holy angels-are with-them together" | "the holy angels are with them together" | "the holy angels are in their midst at all times" | Structural | SOPHIA: "the holy angels are in their midst at all times" — PNEUMA clearer |
| 14 | 5:15 | "the place-of the hand" | "the latrine" | "the latrine area" | Euphemism | SOPHIA: "the latrine" — LOGOS; Hebrew euphemism opaque in English |
| 15 | 5:16 | "unseemly nakedness-of any-thing" | "indecent nakedness" | "nothing indecent" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "nothing indecent" — PNEUMA's concision; cf. same decision at 2:7 |
| 16 | 5:17 | "men-of understanding" | "men of understanding" | "capable, experienced men" | Word choice | SOPHIA: "men of understanding" — LOGOS; Hebrew 'anshei binah is a wisdom term |

**Total disagreements: 16**
